profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs expanded learning programs for Bay Area middle school students. It partners with schools, colleges, companies and families to offer project-based classes taught by career experts and community mentors. The organization grew out of Citizen Schools California.

sources.title: Envisioneers (formerly Citizen Schools California) - Crescent Porter Hale Foundation

review.notes: Envisioneers Inc is a nonprofit (EIN 86-2828543) and a former Citizen Schools California division; Citizen Schools ran Oakland Unified programs, and Idealist and search results place the organization in Redwood City, matching the agenda. The summary, website, email and San Francisco address are supported by the organization's own site and ProPublica, and the summary is neutral.
